# Sonic Pi Track Creation Prompt Template
# Use this template to specify all details for a new Sonic Pi track.
# Fill in as much detail as possible to help Copilot generate your custom script.

## Track Title:
Clarity

## Style/Genre:
EDM / Electro House / Pop

## Reference Song(s) or Artist(s):
Zedd - Clarity

## Tempo (BPM):
130

## Key/Scale:
A♭ Major

## Chord Progression:
A♭ – Fm – Cm – D♭
(These chords are built off the 1st, 6th, 3rd, and 4th degrees of the A♭ major scale)

## Main Instruments:
:prophet (for lush synth leads)
:blade (for edgy, modulated synths)
:piano (for intro and breakdowns)
:saw (for supersaw-style chords in the drop)

## Drum Pattern:
Kick: :bd_tek
Snare/Clap: :sn_dolf
Hi-hats: :drum_cymbal_closed, :drum_cymbal_open
Fills: Layered with :elec_blip, :drum_tom_mid_soft

## Melody:
Bright, soaring lead melody in the chorus
Uses scale tones from A♭ major, often emphasizing the 3rd and 5th
Syncopated rhythm with a mix of long sustained notes and quick flourishes

## Bassline:
Sidechained, punchy synth bass
Follows root notes of the chords (A♭, F, C, D♭)
Rhythmic and driving, especially in the drop

## Effects:
:reverb (on vocals and synths)
:echo (on melodic fills)
Sidechain compression (ducking synths to the kick)
Filter sweeps and riser FX for transitions

## Arrangement/Structure:
Intro – Ambient pads and piano (8 bars)
Verse – Vocals with light instrumentation (16 bars)
Pre-Chorus – Build-up with rising tension (8 bars)
Chorus/Drop – Full synths and drums (16 bars)
Verse 2 – Similar to first verse (16 bars)
Pre-Chorus – Repeated with variation (8 bars)
Chorus/Drop – Repeated with added layers (16 bars)
Bridge – Stripped down, emotional (8 bars)
Final Chorus/Drop – Climactic (16 bars)
Outro – Fade out with piano and pads (8 bars)

## Special Features:
Live loops for drums and synth layers
Automation of filter cutoff and reverb
Breakdowns with minimal instrumentation
Risers and impacts for transitions

## Mood/Atmosphere:
Emotional, uplifting, dramatic, and euphoric

## Additional Notes:
Vocals are central to the emotional impact—consider using a vocal sample or synth lead that mimics vocal phrasing.
The drop should contrast the verse with high energy and layered textures.
Use automation to build tension and release dynamically.
